title: 第1360章 大结局终章第1359章 大军降临
lines: 高山突然收起嬉笑的面孔缓缓腾空，指着那一座座跪拜铜像道:“这就是我为你们准备的厚礼，也是警告你们即将的下场，你们所有人和他们一样。”
“未来这里将是一片跪拜冢，也是你们的屈辱地，你们这群破坏别人家园的入侵者将永远的跪着，永世不得翻身。”
这是羞辱也是赤果果的挑衅。
余战恶狠狠的喊道:“高山，这笔仇我记下了，这笔债由所有华夏生灵性命来偿还，你准备接招吧。将所有铜像都挖掘出来，将他们尸身尽量保存下来。”
高山没有阻止，只是在远处跳首凝望，等着看好戏。
无数人开始动手的时候，高山突然带人向后退了退，对不远处的周彬点了点头，回身对符部的人叮嘱道:“接下来就该到我们了，这一战我们符部才是打响第一战的冲锋战士。”
“放心吧，我们绝对不会给符部丢脸的。”
很快，就有不少的跪拜雕像被挖了出来。
周彬看准了时机喊道:“开爆！”
符部的修炼者立即开始结印，然后轰隆隆响声不停。
一个个铜像突然炸开，引的周边的修炼者也被炸但，有的被炸的四分五裂。
一瞬间，入侵修炼者大军就被淹没在了烟尘中。
“这是我送你们的第二份礼物。”高山得意的呼喊。
那些跪拜铜像可不只是为了气人的，里面埋下了大量的爆裂灵符，先给这些入侵修炼者来上一个下马威。
入侵的修炼者顿时间乱成了一片。
高山又喊道:“还有第三个礼物呢！”
此时入侵的修炼者已经有人感觉到了，觉得肢体有些麻木，行动不畅。
高山给下的第三个礼物就是麻痹毒药，也都被安放在了跪拜铜像内。
他本想安放剧毒的，但是需要量太大很难调配，而且风险极高，医门人万一中招就麻烦了。
这种麻痹性毒药时效短，好配置，解药也很好弄可以大量产出。
“服药，跟我杀！”高山呼喊一声。
医门人立即服下解药，然后冲杀进去。
外来修炼者本就乱做一团，又身体麻痹，面对着冲来的医门的人就更慌了，四处进行逃窜。
“都别乱！”余战吼叫着，暴跳如雷，看到高山，嘶吼道，“我杀了你！”
“滚开！”孟星河三尖两刃刀劈出。
“你也太狂了吧，真以为自己无敌？”
一个声音传出，接着就看到一个老者突然出现，挡下了孟星河的一击。
高山凝视着老者心底颤抖，这老者肯定就是超越了孕婴的至强者。
污染星球已经成了腐朽之地，虽有传承，但是无资源供给，所以修炼变得无比艰难，实力不复史前，不然他们根本没任何机会抵挡。
污染星球上想修炼到孕婴大能无比艰难，想要超脱孕婴更是难如登天一般。
但还是有这样的存在，这也是他们明知道有老神存在可还是敢出手的原因。
一个超脱孕婴的至强者挡住了孟星河，余战再次杀来，不过刚一接近一个小女孩飞上，一鞭子将余战抽飞了出去。
妹妹九天玄女力量发作将余战打飞出去。
余战也是很憋屈，一个最顶级的孕婴大能却连续被拍飞，不过他也没办法，毕竟都是古仙神出手。
“小丫头，我来会会你。”又是一个超脱孕婴的至强者出现。
高山担心道:“妹妹小心点。”
这时候，潘老爷子走出站到了高山身边，释放出强大的气场。
又是一个古仙神，余战不敢再出手了，不然的话怕是又要被拍飞。
“多年没出手了，也该活动活动了。”又是一个阴沉声音传来。
content_en:
Gao Shan suddenly put away his smiling face and slowly rose into the air. He pointed at the bronze statues kneeling down and said, "This is the generous gift I have prepared for you. It is also a warning of your upcoming fate. All of you are the same as them."
"In the future, this place will be a place of worship and a place of humiliation for you. You invaders who destroyed other people's homes will be kneeling forever and will never be able to stand up."
This is both a humiliation and a provocation from Chi Guoguo.
Yu Zhan shouted fiercely: "Gaoshan, I have recorded this debt. This debt will be repaid by all Chinese beings. You are ready to take the attack. Excavate all the bronze statues and preserve their bodies as much as possible."
Gao Shan didn't stop him, he just stared in the distance, waiting for a good show.
When countless people started to take action, Gao Shan suddenly led the people back, nodded to Zhou Bin who was not far away, turned around and warned the people of the Fu Department: "It's our turn next. In this battle, we, the Fu Department, are the charging warriors who started the first battle."
"Don't worry, we will never embarrass Fu Bu."
Soon, many kneeling statues were dug out.
Zhou Bin saw the opportunity and shouted: "Explode!"
The practitioners of the Fu Department immediately began to form seals, and then the rumbling sound continued.
One by one, the bronze statues suddenly exploded, causing the surrounding cultivators to also be blown up, and some were blown to pieces.
In an instant, the army of invading cultivators was drowned in smoke and dust.
"This is my second gift to you." Gao Shan shouted proudly.
Those kneeling down and worshiping the bronze statues were not just for the purpose of irritating people. A large number of explosive talismans were buried inside to give these invading cultivators a first blow.
The invading cultivators suddenly became chaotic.
Gao Shan shouted again: "There is a third gift!"
At this time, some of the invading cultivators have already felt it, feeling numb in their limbs and unable to move smoothly.
The third gift given by Gao Shan was paralyzing poison, which was also placed in the bronze statue of kneeling and worshiping.
He originally wanted to plant a highly poisonous one, but the required amount was too large and difficult to prepare, and the risk was extremely high. If the medical staff was infected, it would be in trouble.
This paralyzing poison has a short effect and is easy to configure. The antidote is also easy to obtain and can be produced in large quantities.
"Take the medicine and kill me!" Gao Shan shouted.
The medical man immediately took the antidote and rushed in.
The outside cultivators were already in a mess and their bodies were paralyzed. Facing the rushing medical staff, they became even more panicked and fled in all directions.
"Don't mess around!" Yu Zhan roared, furious, and when he saw the mountain, he roared, "I'll kill you!"
"Get away!" Meng Xinghe struck out with a three-pointed, two-edged sword.
"Are you too crazy? Do you really think you are invincible?"
A voice came out, and then an old man suddenly appeared and blocked Meng Xinghe's blow.
Gao Shan stared at the old man and his heart trembled. This old man must be the most powerful person who has surpassed pregnant women.
The polluted planet has become a place of decay. Although there is inheritance, there is no resource supply, so cultivation has become extremely difficult, and the strength is no longer what it was before history, otherwise they would have no chance to resist.
It is extremely difficult to cultivate to the power of pregnancy and infants on a polluted planet, and it is even more difficult to transcend pregnancy and infants.
But there are still such existences, which is why they still dare to take action even though they know that there is an old god.
A powerful person who transcended the pregnant woman blocked Meng Xinghe, and Yu Zhan came to kill him again, but as soon as he got close, a little girl flew up and whipped Yu Zhan away with a whip.
My younger sister, Jiutian Xuannv, exploded with power and knocked Yu Zhan away.
Yu Zhan was also very aggrieved. A top expert on pregnant women was shot away one after another, but there was nothing he could do. After all, it was all done by ancient immortals and gods.
"Little girl, I'm here to meet you." Another powerful person who transcended the pregnancy and infant appeared.
Gao Shan worriedly said: "Sister, be careful."
At this time, Mr. Pan stepped out and stood next to Gao Shan, releasing a powerful aura.
It was another ancient immortal god. Yu Zhan did not dare to take action again, otherwise he would be shot away again.
"I haven't taken action for many years, it's time to get active." Another gloomy voice came.
